title: Widgets — iOS WidgetKit (@bacons/apple-targets) + Android app widgets (react-native-android-widget) + Kotlin Chronometer module
description: NATIVE MODULE: changes the runtime fingerprint. iOS: SwiftUI widget target outside ios/ (CNG-safe), App Group + ExtensionStorage to share data, Text(.timer) counts natively. Android: JSX widgets rendered to RemoteViews (day-level, update via AlarmManager at midnight) plus a tiny Expo Module exposing a Chronometer widget for hour/minute/second countdowns (the Android system ticks it, no updates). Needs Xcode 16+, EAS build (not Expo Go). Android side compiles and registers (see verified); iOS target + on-device ticking still to verify.
verified: 2026-09-05: Android — prebuild + gradle OK, both providers registered (API 34 emulator). iOS — pod install (CocoaPods 1.16.2) + xcodebuild green incl. Countdown.appex; on an iPhone 15 Pro simulator the app's publishWidgetData wrote the app-group plist via ExtensionStorage and the appex registered with WidgetKit (pluginkit -m). Not yet verified: widget rendered on a Home/Lock Screen (simulator widget gallery was blank — test on device), Android widget placed and ticking.
